items.name: Crispy Calamari
items.description: Tender rings of fresh squid lightly dusted in seasoned flour and fried until golden. Served with a zesty lemon aioli and chilli flakes.

items.name: Beef Broth Soup
items.description: Rich slow-simmered beef bone broth with shredded tenderloin, garden vegetables and fresh herbs. Warming and deeply flavourful.

items.name: Bruschetta al Pomodoro
items.description: Toasted sourdough rubbed with garlic, topped with ripe diced tomatoes, fresh basil and a drizzle of extra-virgin olive oil.

items.name: Pumpkin Cream Soup
items.description: Velvety roasted pumpkin purée with coconut milk, ginger and a swirl of cream. Served with toasted pumpkin seeds.

items.name: Garlic Prawn Skewers
items.description: Plump tiger prawns marinated in garlic butter, lemon and smoked paprika. Grilled on skewers and served over dressed greens.

items.name: Chicken Liver Pâté
items.description: Smooth and rich chicken liver pâté with caramelised onions, a touch of brandy and fresh thyme. Served with toasted ciabatta.

items.name: Tomato Basil Soup
items.description: Classic slow-roasted tomato soup blended with fresh basil and a splash of cream. Served with a grilled cheese crouton on top.

items.name: Loaded Potato Skins
items.description: Crispy baked potato skins filled with melted cheddar, sour cream and chives. A crowd-pleasing bar-style snack.

items.name: Grilled Sirloin Steak
items.description: 250g prime beef sirloin grilled to your preference, finished with herb butter. Served with roasted garlic and a red wine jus.

items.name: Herb Roasted Chicken
items.description: Half chicken marinated in rosemary, thyme, garlic and lemon. Slow-roasted until golden and juicy, served with pan drippings.

items.name: Pan-Seared Tilapia
items.description: Whole tilapia fillet pan-seared in brown butter with capers and dill. Light, flaky and perfectly seasoned.

items.name: Slow-Braised Beef Short Ribs
items.description: Beef short ribs braised for 6 hours in red wine and aromatics until fall-off-the-bone tender. Served with creamy mash.

items.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
items.description: Tender chunks of marinated chicken in a rich, aromatic tomato-cream curry. Served with steamed basmati rice and naan.

items.name: Grilled Salmon Fillet
items.description: Atlantic salmon fillet grilled over charcoal with lemon-dill butter. Served with sautéed spinach and wedge of lemon.

items.name: Lamb Chops with Mint Jus
items.description: Three tender lamb loin chops seasoned with cumin and coriander, grilled and finished with a fresh mint and garlic jus.

items.name: Beef Burger Classic
items.description: 180g hand-formed beef patty, toasted brioche bun, aged cheddar, lettuce, tomato, pickles and house burger sauce.

items.name: Butter Chicken
items.description: Classic Punjabi butter chicken — yoghurt-marinated chicken in a silky tomato-butter-cream sauce. Mild, fragrant and rich.

items.name: Whole Grilled Snapper
items.description: Fresh whole red snapper scored and grilled over open flame with garlic, chilli and lime. Served with a tropical mango salsa.

items.name: Vegetable Coconut Curry
items.description: Seasonal vegetables — courgette, chickpeas, sweet potato and spinach — simmered in a fragrant coconut and lemongrass curry. Served with rice.

items.name: Chicken Schnitzel
items.description: Flattened chicken breast coated in crispy panko breadcrumbs, pan-fried golden. Served with creamy mushroom sauce.

items.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
items.description: Authentic Roman carbonara — spaghetti tossed with crispy pancetta, egg yolk, Pecorino Romano and black pepper. No cream.

items.name: Penne Arrabbiata
items.description: Penne pasta in a fierce, spicy tomato and garlic sauce with fresh chilli and basil. Simple, punchy and satisfying.

items.name: Fettuccine Alfredo
items.description: Wide ribbon pasta in a luxurious Parmesan cream sauce. Finished with grilled chicken breast and fresh parsley.

items.name: Steamed Basmati Rice
items.description: Fragrant long-grain basmati rice steamed with a bay leaf and cardamom. Light, fluffy and the perfect base for any curry or stew.

items.name: Chicken Fried Rice
items.description: Wok-tossed jasmine rice with diced chicken, egg, spring onions, garlic and soy sauce. Light smoke from the wok, crispy edges.

items.name: Mushroom Risotto
items.description: Arborio rice slow-cooked with mixed wild mushrooms, white wine and Parmesan until creamy and al dente. Finished with truffle oil.

items.name: Hand-Cut Chips
items.description: Thick-cut potato chips double-fried for a crispy shell and fluffy centre. Seasoned with sea salt and served with house ketchup.

items.name: Creamy Mashed Potato
items.description: Yukon Gold potatoes mashed with butter, warm cream and a pinch of nutmeg until silky smooth. Rich and comforting.

items.name: Sautéed Garlic Spinach
items.description: Fresh baby spinach wilted in a hot pan with garlic, olive oil, sea salt and a squeeze of lemon. Vibrant and nutritious.

items.name: Roasted Root Vegetables
items.description: Seasonal carrots, parsnips and beetroot tossed in olive oil, honey and thyme, roasted until caramelised and tender.

items.name: Steamed Broccoli & Tenderstem
items.description: Tenderstem broccoli and florets steamed until bright green and just tender. Dressed with a lemon and almond butter.

items.name: Grilled Corn on the Cob
items.description: Sweet corn grilled on open flame until charred, brushed with herb butter and a dusting of chilli powder.

items.name: Chocolate Fondant
items.description: Warm dark chocolate cake with a molten centre, dusted with icing sugar. Served with a scoop of vanilla bean ice cream.

items.name: Classic Crème Brûlée
items.description: Silky vanilla custard set in a ramekin and finished with a perfectly caramelised sugar crust. Crack and enjoy.

items.name: New York Cheesecake
items.description: Dense and creamy baked cheesecake on a buttery digestive biscuit base. Served with a fresh strawberry compote.

items.name: Mango Panna Cotta
items.description: Light Italian-style panna cotta infused with fresh Kenyan mango. Set in a glass and topped with mango coulis and mint.

items.name: Banana Foster Pancakes
items.description: Fluffy buttermilk pancakes topped with caramelised banana in brown sugar rum sauce and a drizzle of cream.

items.name: Tiramisu
items.description: Classic Italian tiramisu — espresso-soaked savoiardi layered with mascarpone cream and dusted with fine cocoa powder.

items.name: Fruit Salad with Cream
items.description: Seasonal fresh fruits — watermelon, pineapple, pawpaw, kiwi and passion fruit — tossed in a honey-lime dressing. Served with whipped cream.

items.name: Warm Malva Pudding
items.description: South African sticky apricot sponge pudding soaked in a warm cream sauce. Served with a side of vanilla custard.

items.name: Still Water
items.description: Chilled still mineral water. Small (500ml) or large (1L) available.

items.name: Coca-Cola
items.description: Ice-cold Coca-Cola served over ice in a tall glass.

items.name: Fresh Orange Juice
items.description: Freshly squeezed Kenyan oranges, no added sugar. Served chilled.

items.name: Mango Passion Smoothie
items.description: Blended fresh mango and passion fruit with yoghurt and a touch of honey. Thick, tropical and refreshing.

items.name: Sparkling Water
items.description: Ice-cold carbonated mineral water with a wedge of lemon.

items.name: Ginger Lemonade
items.description: Housemade lemonade with a kick of fresh ginger, mint leaves and a pinch of cayenne. Served over ice.

items.name: Hot Coffee
items.description: Freshly brewed Kenyan AA coffee. Choose: espresso, Americano, cappuccino or flat white.

items.name: Dessert Wine Glass
items.description: A glass of chilled sweet dessert wine. Ask your waiter for today's selection.

items.name: Masala Chai
items.description: Kenyan tea brewed strong with milk, cardamom, ginger, cinnamon and black pepper. The ultimate comfort drink.

items.name: Virgin Mojito
items.description: Muddled fresh mint and lime with sugar syrup, topped with sparkling water and crushed ice. Bright and refreshing.
